","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,"],"sigma":2.0,"limits":{"base":14.0,"run1":6.0,"run3":9.0},"frame_count":51}</script>
<script id="viewer-script">
'use strict';
const data=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('frame-data').textContent);
const get=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let index=23,timer=null;
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
function draw(){
 const lag=Number(get('lag').value),key='run'+lag;
 get('frame').value=index;get('number').value=pad(index)+' / 50';
 get('original').src=data.original[index];get('base').src=data.base[index];
 const available=index>=lag;
 get('running').hidden=!available;get('missing').hidden=available;
 if(available)get('running').src=data[key][index];
 get('original-caption').textContent='Original: NOAA/GOES-16 SUVI 195 Å · frame '+pad(index)+' · preview JPEG colours.';
 get('base-caption').textContent='Frame '+pad(index)+' minus frame 00 · scale ±14.';
 get('running-caption').textContent=available?'Frame '+pad(index)+' minus frame '+pad(index-lag)+' · scale ±'+data.limits[key]+'.':'No earlier frame is available at this separation.';
 get('previous').disabled=index===0;get('next').disabled=index===50;
}
function stop(){if(timer!==null)clearInterval(timer);timer=null;get('play').textContent='Play';get('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');}
function start(){stop();if(index===50)index=0;draw();get('play').textContent='Pause';get('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');timer=setInterval(()=>{if(index>=50){stop();return;}index++;draw();},Number(get('speed').value));}
get('play').addEventListener('click',()=>timer===null?start():stop());
get('previous').addEventListener('click',()=>{stop();index=Math.max(0,index-1);draw();});
get('next').addEventListener('click',()=>{stop();index=Math.min(50,index+1);draw();});
get('frame').addEventListener('input',()=>{stop();index=Number(get('frame').value);draw();});
get('lag').addEventListener('change',draw);
get('speed').addEventListener('change',()=>{if(timer!==null)start();});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stop();});
draw();
</script>
</body></html>
